vocabulary.definition: 一次施放或一次攻击能对多个敌方单位造成伤害
移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果
移除目标身上可被强驱散的效果（含多数眩晕）
让普通攻击附带额外效果：减甲、减速、减疗、烧蓝、额外伤害、中毒、降低属性等；有概率触发或只强化下一次攻击也算。单纯提高攻击力、攻速，以及吸血、暴击、分裂弹射归各自词条
跟着单位持续影响周围单位；对友军或敌方都算，并记作用对象；固定在地上的区域归场地魔法
攻击或技能造成重击（眩晕目标）；有概率、固定攻击次数或技能触发都算
使敌方单位的攻击有概率落空
攻击伤害波及周围单位
立刻重置冷却
攻击造成额外倍数伤害；有概率触发或强化下一次攻击都算
目标无法普通攻击
恢复生命值（治疗、生命恢复），含属性生命恢复（如治疗指环+4.5）
使自身、队友、召唤物或复制体隐身
暂时无法被伤害或无法被指向
攻击或技能恢复自身生命：按造成的伤害、按目标生命或每次攻击固定值（攻击吸血、技能吸血、如噬魂鬼·盛宴、附魂面具）
降低目标魔抗，或让目标受到更多魔法或技能伤害
为自己恢复或从其他单位抽取法力（如莱恩法力吸取），含属性回蓝和回蓝倍率；对友军生效且能给自己回蓝的也算
移动不受单位碰撞阻挡
攻击无视闪避（必中）
效果对处于减益免疫的敌方仍生效（技能看immunity=3，装备看官方说明）
降低目标的视野
死亡后复活，或影响复活
目标无法施放技能（仍可攻击、使用物品）
降低移动速度或攻击速度
降低自身受到的减速效果（如散夜对剑+30%）
提高技能造成的伤害
缩短自身受到的控制与减益的持续时间（如散夜对剑+16%）
使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
能摧毁树木

objects.subject: ringmaster_funhouse_mirror
objects.description_zh: 使用：比例失真制造英雄的%images_count%个不完美幻象，持续%illusion_duration%秒。幻象继承%tooltip_damage_outgoing_ranged%%%攻击力，承受%tooltip_damage_incoming_total_pct%%%伤害。
objects.description_en: Use: Proportion DistortionCreates %images_count% imperfect image of your hero that lasts %illusion_duration% seconds. Your illusion deals %tooltip_damage_outgoing_ranged%%% and takes  %tooltip_damage_incoming_total_pct%%% damage.
notes_zh: 有%invuln_duration%秒的施法时间，其间处于无敌状态。

objects.subject: ringmaster_whoopee_cushion
objects.description_zh: 使用：噗把英雄向前推动%leap_distance%距离。在身后留下一团%fart_cloud_radius%范围的臭云，持续%fart_cloud_duration%秒，使敌人减速%fart_cloud_slow%%%。
objects.description_en: Use: WhoopsiePropels your hero forward %leap_distance% units. Leaves a %fart_cloud_radius% radius stink cloud behind for %fart_cloud_duration% seconds that slows enemies by %fart_cloud_slow%%%.

objects.subject: ringmaster_summon_unicycle
objects.description_zh: 使用：上车召唤一辆快速的独轮车并骑上去，持续%mount_duration%秒。上车%damage_grace_period%秒后受到来自敌方英雄的伤害超过%damage_threshold%点会让他下车。撞到树木会将其摧毁，并且独轮车会减速。攻击、使用持续施法类技能或者撞到单位和其他障碍物都会使他下车。
objects.description_en: Use: Saddle UpSummons a speedy unicycle to ride around on for %mount_duration% seconds. %damage_grace_period%s after mounting the unicycle, taking damage from enemy hero sources greater than %damage_threshold% dismounts the rider. Crashing into trees destroys them and slows the unicycle. Attacking, using channeled abilities, or crashing into units and other obstacles also dismounts the rider.

objects.subject: kez_echo_slash
objects.description_zh: 凯挥舞他的长刀向前沿一条直线斩击%katana_distance%距离，攻击区域内的敌人并施加短暂的%tag_slow%%%减速。经过短暂延迟后，这个区域会被再次攻击。英雄会承受额外伤害。
objects.description_en: Kez slashes forward in a %katana_distance% distance line with his Katana, attacking enemies in an area and applying a brief %tag_slow%%% impact slow. After a short delay, the area is attacked again. Heroes take bonus damage.
notes_zh: 会摧毁树木。不会继承分裂效果。

objects.subject: kez_grappling_claw
objects.description_zh: 凯向目标单位或者树木发射一枚抓钩并摆荡过去。抓钩碰到目标后，该单位会被减速。凯到达敌方目标时，落地会发动一次攻击。
objects.description_en: Kez swings on a grappling hook towards the target unit or tree.  When the grappling hook collides with the target, that unit has slowed movement speed. Upon reaching the enemy target, Kez lands an attack on them.

objects.subject: kez_kazurai_katana
objects.description_zh: 长刀的攻击和技能会对敌人施加一个可叠加的持续伤害效果，持续时间内造成原攻击伤害一定百分比的额外伤害。凯可以主动使用技能，刺中目标，阻止他们移动或转身。目标身上的影武长刀效果爆发，使部分叠加数值立刻造成伤害。
objects.description_en: Katana attacks and abilities apply a stacking damage over time to enemies that deals a percentage of the original attack's damage as additional damage over time. Kez may activate the ability to impale the target with his attack, preventing them from moving or turning. The target's Katana debuff bursts, causing some of the stacks to deal damage instantly.

shard.zh: 刺中后凯能从当次攻击吸血%lifesteal_pct%%%。如果从背后刺中目标，目标会被眩晕。提升最大爆发叠加数值。
shard.en: Kez lifesteals %lifesteal_pct%%% from the impale. If the impale comes from behind the target, the target is stunned. Increases max burst stacks.

objects.subject: kez_switch_weapons
objects.description_zh: 凯可以在影武长刀和翔影双钗之间变换。基于装备的武器，他会获得不同的攻击特性和技能。技能会一起升级，而且使用后，相对的武器技能也会进入冷却。凯切换到长刀后第一次长刀攻击或技能会造成额外伤害，切换到双钗后会获得额外移动速度。
objects.description_en: Kez switches between his Kazurai Katana and Shodo Sai.He gains different attack capabilities and abilities based on the weapon equipped. The abilities level up together, and when an ability is used, the associated alternate weapon ability also goes on cooldown.Kez deals extra damage on the first Katana hit or ability after switching to Katana, and gains bonus speed after switching to Sai.

scepter.zh: 在使用流派变换后%scepter_cooldown_timer%秒内施放的第一个技能不会使相对的武器技能进入冷却，或者已进入冷却的技能会结束冷却。施放任何武器的技能都会重置流派变换的冷却时间。
scepter.en: Casting a weapon ability that would set its alternate weapon ability on cooldown does not do so if it's the first one used within %scepter_cooldown_timer% seconds after casting Switch Discipline or if it was already on cooldown.Casting any weapon ability refreshes the cooldown of Switch Discipline.

objects.subject: kez_raptor_dance
objects.description_zh: 凯进入不可控制的状态，持续%AbilityCastPoint%秒，%invuln_period%秒为无敌状态并获得一次弱驱散效果。如果施法成功完成，凯会对周围发动致命的辐射状斩击，基于目标的最大生命值造成伤害，并且造成伤害的一定百分比会治疗凯。
objects.description_en: Kez enters into an uncontrollable state for %AbilityCastPoint% second, becoming invulnerable for %invuln_period%s and receiving a basic dispel.If the cast completes successfully, Kez performs a series of deadly radial slashes around him that deal damage based on the max health of the target and heal Kez for a percentage of all damage dealt.
notes_zh: 斩击非英雄单位或幻象时吸血量减少至%illusion_lifesteal_pct%%%。

objects.subject: kez_falcon_rush
objects.description_zh: 开启后凯可以向敌方目标冲去，发动的攻击会重复一次。在这个状态下，凯拥有相位移动状态和减速抗性。
objects.description_en: Kez gains the ability to rush towards enemy targets to deliver echoing secondary attacks.  While in this state, Kez has phased collision and slow resistance.

objects.subject: kez_talon_toss
objects.description_zh: 凯向目标单位掷出一把钗，施加一次固定伤害的攻击，并造成沉默。
objects.description_en: Kez throws a Sai at the target unit, applying a fixed damage attack and silence.
notes_zh: 固定伤害的攻击具有克敌机先效果。

objects.subject: kez_shodo_sai
objects.description_zh: 装备双钗时凯的攻击有几率对敌人造成致命一击。凯可以主动开启技能，使自身被缴械，面朝方向被锁定，招架来自目标方向的攻击和攻击效果，持续%parry_duration%秒。如果有敌方英雄的攻击被招架，该英雄会被眩晕%parry_stun_duration%秒并获得印记，拥有印记的目标被凯攻击时必定会造成致命一击，并且被眩晕。子技能可以用于提前取消招架状态。
objects.description_en: Kez has a chance to critically strike the target when attacking with Sais.Kez may activate the ability to disarm himself, lock his facing, and parry attacks and attack effects from the targeted direction for %parry_duration% seconds. If an attack is parried from an enemy Hero in this way, that Hero is stunned for %parry_stun_duration%s and gains a Mark.  When a Marked target is attacked by Kez, it will guarantee a critical strike and stun the target.The sub-ability may be used to cancel the blocking early.

shard.zh: 招架会产生更强的印记，造成额外眩晕和致命一击伤害。
shard.en: Parrying creates a stronger Mark that deals additional stun and critical damage.

objects.subject: kez_ravens_veil
objects.description_zh: 凯释放出一阵迷烟，对附近敌方英雄施加标记，暂时削弱他们的视野。凯获得弱驱散效果、移动速度加成和隐身状态，直到他攻击或施法。
objects.description_en: Kez releases a wave of smoke that applies his Mark to nearby enemy heroes, briefly reducing their vision. Kez receives a basic dispel and gains bonus movement speed and invisibility until he attacks or casts a spell.

objects.subject: largo_catchy_lick
objects.description_zh:
朗戈用他的舌头舔舐目标单位，把它拉回一小段距离，施加弱驱散，如果是敌人还会造成伤害。

击杀目标或驱散目标的效果后都会使朗戈暂时获得生命恢复。

驱散类型：弱驱散
objects.description_en:
Largo licks the targeted unit with his tongue, pulling it back a short distance, applying a basic dispel, and dealing damage if it's an enemy.

Killing or dispelling an effect from a target grants Largo temporary health regeneration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes_zh: 可以舔舐神符，将其牵引。

objects.subject: largo_frogstomp
objects.description_zh: 朗戈把小青蛙扔到一片区域。他们每%stomp_interval%秒都会践踏地面，造成伤害和短暂眩晕并且区域内敌人的移动速度会被减缓。
objects.description_en: Largo tosses froglings to an area. They stomp the ground every %stomp_interval% second, dealing damage and ministuns, and enemies in the area have reduced movement speed.

objects.subject: largo_croak_of_genius
objects.description_zh:
朗戈对一名友方英雄弹奏一首小调。英雄的技能和物品拥有的魔法消耗降低，并且造成伤害后会回响，接下来%damage_duration%秒内再次造成原本伤害的一定百分比。

只要作用下的英雄消耗了魔法，本增益的剩余持续时间都会减少%duration_reduction%秒。朗戈身上的持续时间不会减少。
objects.description_en:
Largo strums a tune to a friendly hero. The hero's items and abilities have reduced mana cost and a percentage of their damage reverberates over the following %damage_duration% seconds.

When an affected hero spends mana, the remaining buff duration is reduced by %duration_reduction%s. Duration is not reduced for Largo himself.
notes_zh: 只适用于可受到技能增强作用的伤害来源。
只会在来源和目标相距%max_distance%以内时施加伤害。

objects.subject: largo_amphibian_rhapsody
objects.description_zh:
朗戈准备好弹奏乐曲。他被缴械，而他的技能栏切换为3个乐曲技能，每个都有不同的效果。乐曲只有弹在节拍上才会生效。

每次成功弹奏他都会获得一层律动的叠加效果。每层叠加效果都会对他提供额外护甲，并且降低每首乐曲的魔法消耗，但是他只要错过一次节拍就会失去一层叠加效果。叠加效果在朗戈的乐曲结束后还会粘滞一小段时间。
objects.description_en:
Largo gets ready to groove. He is disarmed and his ability bar switches to 3 song abilities, each with different effects. Songs are only effective if strummed on the beat.

Every time he strums successfully, he gains a stack of Groovin'. Each stack gives him bonus armor and reduces the mana cost of every song, but he loses a stack if he misses a beat. Stacks linger for a short duration when Largo's song ends.
notes_zh: 这个模式下可以使用物品。

scepter.zh: 朗戈在每次节拍时可以弹奏两首乐曲。
scepter.en: Largo can play two songs per beat by strumming both at the same time.

objects.subject: largo_song_fight_song
objects.description_zh: 朗戈弹奏的乐曲对附近敌人造成%burst_damage%点魔法伤害。乐曲还会使附近友方英雄的技能增强提升，并且他们的攻击造成额外魔法伤害。
objects.description_en: Largo plays a song that deals %burst_damage% magical damage to nearby enemies. The song also increases nearby allied heroes' spell amplification and grants their attacks additional magic damage.

scepter.zh: 这首乐曲用于两首共弹时每层律动都会额外造成%damage_per_stack%点魔法伤害。
scepter.en: Deals additional %damage_per_stack% magic damage per Groovin' stack when this song is used in double-strumming.

objects.subject: largo_song_double_time
objects.description_zh: 朗戈弹奏的乐曲会提升附近友方单位的移动速度，还有短时间的减速抗性。
objects.description_en: Largo plays a song that increases nearby friendly units' movement speed and grants a brief slow resistance.

objects.subject: largo_song_good_vibrations
objects.description_zh: 朗戈弹奏的乐曲会治疗附近友方英雄。
objects.description_en: Largo plays a song that heals nearby friendly heroes.

objects.subject: abyssal_blade
objects.description_en: Active: Overwhelm  Stuns a target enemy unit for %stun_duration% seconds.   Pierces Debuff Immunity.   Passive: Bash  Grants melee heroes a %bash_chance_melee%%% chance on hit to stun the target for %bash_duration% seconds and deal %bonus_chance_damage% bonus physical damage.  Bash chance for ranged heroes is %bash_chance_ranged%%%.
notes_en: Does not stack with other bashes, and does not grant bash to Clones and Tempest Doubles.
Multiple sources of damage block do not stack.
The following heroes cannot trigger Bash on this item: Spirit Breaker, Faceless Void, Slardar, and Kez while in Sai mode.

objects.subject: aegis
objects.description_en: Passive: Reincarnation  Brings you to life with full health and mana %reincarnate_time% seconds after you die, at the location where you died.   Reincarnation must be used within %disappear_time_minutes_tooltip% minutes or Aegis of the Immortal disappears. If it expires, it will heal you over 5 seconds (dispels on damage).

objects.subject: aeon_disk
objects.description_en: Passive: Combo Breaker  When you take damage and your health falls below %health_threshold_pct%%%, a strong dispel is applied and you gain a %buff_duration% second buff that provides +%status_resistance%%% Status Resistance and causes all damage you deal and are dealt to be reduced to zero. Only triggers on player based damage. Cooldown increases every time it triggers.  Dispel Type:  Strong Dispel

objects.subject: aether_lens
notes_en: Cast Range bonuses from Aether Lens and Dagon do not stack.

objects.subject: ancient_janggo
objects.description_en: Active: Endurance  Gives +%bonus_attack_speed_pct% attack speed and +%bonus_movement_speed_pct%%% movement speed to nearby allies for %duration% seconds.  Radius: %radius%     Passive: Swiftness Aura Grants %aura_movement_speed% movement speed and %aura_health_regen% health regeneration to allies.    Radius: %radius%

objects.subject: angels_demise
objects.description_en: Passive: Empower Spell  The next Unit Target spell you cast on an enemy deals a separate %bonus_spell_damage% additional damage, disables their passives, and slows their movement speed by %slow%%% for %slow_duration%s.
notes_en: The break debuff is not dispellable.
